Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants, multiple 4G EPC and 5G Core providers, and the seven test streams (A through G), the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per MCX client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. The deployment of three 4G networks (Bands 38/40) and four 5G networks (Band 78) further increased the complexity of SIM card management. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team, a unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful.
Need for frequency management. The deployment of multiple 4G and 5G radio equipment across seven networks required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission from ARCEP (the French spectrum regulator) and coordinating in specific frequency bands, namely Bands 38, and 40 for 4G and Band 78 for 5G.
Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some EPC and 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face-to-face event. Unique PLMN IDs should be used for each 4G or 5G network present in the Plugtests and support of these PLMN IDs must be supported by the UEs.
Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 10th MCX Plugtests specific provisioning information was shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including PLMN IDs to be used, details for the domains/realms, Application Server information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects (MOs) according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone, consuming a non-negligible part of the test sessions, especially in those involving multiple clients and/or servers.
Role of the SIP/IMS cores and SIM cards. Similarly to the previous, the usage of SIM based authentication and derivation of SIP identities and realms from the ISIM within the physical SIM card for SIP registration and IMS-AKA based authentication is still not available in many MCX clients/UE vendors. Similarly, the automated discovery of PCSCF from the 4G or 5G network signalling was not used. Instead, manual configuration for every SIP/IMS core registrar server was needed, leading again to delays.
MTU and fragmentation issues. The testing setups typically involve connecting to components in different networks (4G, 5G, Ethernet, VPN) even remotely through the ETSI HIVE, with different MTU sizes. Since there is no agreed PMTU discovery mechanism in place and sometimes the MCX components do/can not properly control the Don't Fragment (DF bit) capabilities in IP datagrams there typically appear hard-to-troubleshoot connectivity issues. Although such issues were also announced and reminded to the participants it was still present during the event.

## 12 Interoperability Implementation Guide The FRMCS and MCX Plugtests test case document (ETSI TS 103 564) specifies interoperability tests with the purpose of supporting those series of events. It therefore follows ETSI Interoperability best practices, including the identification of requirements specific methods, techniques and tools to be used, the naming conventions including test components and test purposes, the definition of test purposes, among others. As part of the testing methodology, whenever an ambiguity or gap in the standards is identified a so-called observation is collected and conveyed to the relevant working group in the standardization organisation for clarification. However, even with a common understanding of the interfaces and standards to be evaluated during the interoperability tests, some practical or implementation questions arise that may have an impact into not only the interoperability testing carried out during the Plugtests themselves but also while deploying FRMCS systems in multivendor scenarios. The following list summarizes some of the findings during the $ 5^{th} $ FRMCS Plugtests. - Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants and 5GC providers, the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per FRMCS client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team an unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful. - Need for frequency management. The deployment of 5 different 5G radio equipment required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission to the spectrum regulator and coordinating in specific frequency bands. - Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face to face event. • Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 5^{th} FRMCS Plugtests (https://wiki.plugtests.net/5th-FRMCS-Plugtests/index.php?title=Provisioning_Information) specific provisioning information is shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including adhoc calling criteria according to UIC FIS document, PLMN IDs to be used, N5 testing approach for AS providers, details for the domains/realms, Application Servers information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects –MOs- according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone.

Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants, multiple 4G EPC and 5G Core providers, and the seven test streams (A through G), the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per MCX client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. The deployment of three 4G networks (Bands 38/40) and four 5G networks (Band 78) further increased the complexity of SIM card management. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team, a unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful.
Need for frequency management. The deployment of multiple 4G and 5G radio equipment across seven networks required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission from ARCEP (the French spectrum regulator) and coordinating in specific frequency bands, namely Bands 38, and 40 for 4G and Band 78 for 5G.
Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some EPC and 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face-to-face event. Unique PLMN IDs should be used for each 4G or 5G network present in the Plugtests and support of these PLMN IDs must be supported by the UEs.
Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 10th MCX Plugtests specific provisioning information was shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including PLMN IDs to be used, details for the domains/realms, Application Server information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects (MOs) according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone, consuming a non-negligible part of the test sessions, especially in those involving multiple clients and/or servers.
Role of the SIP/IMS cores and SIM cards. Similarly to the previous, the usage of SIM based authentication and derivation of SIP identities and realms from the ISIM within the physical SIM card for SIP registration and IMS-AKA based authentication is still not available in many MCX clients/UE vendors. Similarly, the automated discovery of PCSCF from the 4G or 5G network signalling was not used. Instead, manual configuration for every SIP/IMS core registrar server was needed, leading again to delays.
MTU and fragmentation issues. The testing setups typically involve connecting to components in different networks (4G, 5G, Ethernet, VPN) even remotely through the ETSI HIVE, with different MTU sizes. Since there is no agreed PMTU discovery mechanism in place and sometimes the MCX components do/can not properly control the Don't Fragment (DF bit) capabilities in IP datagrams there typically appear hard-to-troubleshoot connectivity issues. Although such issues were also announced and reminded to the participants it was still present during the event.

## 12 Interoperability Implementation Guide The FRMCS and MCX Plugtests test case document (ETSI TS 103 564) specifies interoperability tests with the purpose of supporting those series of events. It therefore follows ETSI Interoperability best practices, including the identification of requirements specific methods, techniques and tools to be used, the naming conventions including test components and test purposes, the definition of test purposes, among others. As part of the testing methodology, whenever an ambiguity or gap in the standards is identified a so-called observation is collected and conveyed to the relevant working group in the standardization organisation for clarification. However, even with a common understanding of the interfaces and standards to be evaluated during the interoperability tests, some practical or implementation questions arise that may have an impact into not only the interoperability testing carried out during the Plugtests themselves but also while deploying FRMCS systems in multivendor scenarios. The following list summarizes some of the findings during the $ 5^{th} $ FRMCS Plugtests. - Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants and 5GC providers, the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per FRMCS client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team an unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful. - Need for frequency management. The deployment of 5 different 5G radio equipment required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission to the spectrum regulator and coordinating in specific frequency bands. - Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face to face event. • Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 5^{th} FRMCS Plugtests (https://wiki.plugtests.net/5th-FRMCS-Plugtests/index.php?title=Provisioning_Information) specific provisioning information is shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including adhoc calling criteria according to UIC FIS document, PLMN IDs to be used, N5 testing approach for AS providers, details for the domains/realms, Application Servers information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects –MOs- according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone.

Once all the tests in the Test Session Report were executed and results recorded, the participants reviewed the Report and approved it. ### 7.4 Identified Challenges During and after the MCX#10 Plugtests participating vendors, observers, and the ETSI Plugtests team made a few observations on potential improvements. These observations will help to organize the next Plugtests better. The main observations highlight the need for longer and better-structured test sessions, improved pre-testing and preparation, earlier and more controlled scheduling, and enhanced coordination for multi-vendor scenarios. Additionally, improvements in resource allocation, participant readiness, and overall session planning would significantly increase testing efficiency and effectiveness. Observations were: - A key observation was that several vendors did not correctly configure their equipment using provisioning information. This resulted in significant time being spent on properly configuring MCX clients during the test sessions. - The allocated two-hour test sessions were generally insufficient to complete full test scenarios. This limitation was particularly evident in multi-vendor sessions, which typically required significantly more time—up to three to four hours—to achieve meaningful results. Consequently, a number of test sessions could not be fully completed, adversely impacting the overall test coverage - Random sessions should also be scheduled during the pre-testing phase, and these sessions should then be continued during the main event. - All vendors should use the IDMS, CMS, and GMS processes for registration and provisioning. • Attending the observer demos may prevent vendors to continue testing. This should not be the case. It may make sense to limit the number of demos a vendor can participate in to ensure vendors can continue testing with other vendors during the time of the observer demos. ## 8 Test Plan Overview ### 8.1 Introduction This $ 10^{th} $ MCX Plugtests Test Plan was developed following ETSI guidelines for interoperability. Additional Release-19- based test cases, comprising Multi-Client scenarios and IWF, were included. The Test Plan was reviewed and discussed with participants during the preparation and pre-testing phase. Considering the huge number of resulting test cases and difference expected maturity of the implementations and differences from participants in the previous Plugtests event and new companies, vendors selected the subset of test cases to evaluate in a per-testing slot basis. The following sections summarise the methodology used for identifying the different configuration and test objectives leading to different test cases subgroups. ### 8.2 Test configurations The overall MCX ecosystem comprises both controlling and participating MCPTT/MCData/MCVideo application server(s), MCPTT Clients deployed over a generic SIP Core/IMS, LTE/5G access network with and without MCPTT required PCC capabilities and native multicast support (i.e. eMBMS). Furthermore, a series of support servers were integrated in the so-called Common Services Core provide configuration, identity, group, and key management capabilities.

Permission System: Role-based access control for pages and functions.
Group Management: Edit groups, members and configurations; support quick group creation via templates.
Device & Service Management: Configure MCX services, access, map and manage SIP terminals in bulk to enable communication across heterogeneous terminals.
License Management: Support download, approval, import and update of License certificates.
### 4.3 Core Voice Services
Basic Calls: Full-duplex/half-duplex individual calls, first-answer calls, auto/manual call answering and call forwarding; compatible with AMR-WB codec.
Group Calls: Regular group calls, chat groups, ad-hoc group calls, late join, free entry & exit and voice broadcast; support call volume threshold policies.
Emergency Voice: Highest-priority emergency individual/group calls, one-click upgrade for regular calls and service downgrade linkage under emergency status.
Talk Permit Control: Exclusive talk permit, time limit, talk permit queuing, high-priority preemption and multi-party simultaneous speaking.
Emergency Alert: Group and individual SOS alerts with push of staff, location and organization information.
### 4.4 Core Video Services
Support auto/manual answering, full-duplex video individual calls and video group calls with late join and free entry & exit. It features video push, remote pull and targeted distribution to meet visualized dispatching requirements.
### 4.5 Multimedia & Data Services
Support point-to-point and group bidirectional transmission of text, voice, images, short videos, locations and files. Compatible with offline message cache and automatic download of small files for lightweight data interaction.
### 4.6 Visual Dispatching & Command
Status Monitoring: Real-time display of online status, emergency status, call status and alert status for all contacts and groups.
Emergency Dispatching: Remote silent environment monitoring, pop-up emergency alerts and tiered callback reminders.
Record & Traceability: Recording for audio & video calls, logs for all calls and multimedia services, and file playback & query.
Location Dispatching: Real-time location display and historical track playback via GIS for personnel situation management.
## 5 Core Advantages
- **High Reliability & Security**
When deployed on carrier networks, it adopts 3GPP QoS mechanisms to guarantee priority and resource reservation for mission-critical services, ensuring normal transmission of high-priority data amid network congestion.
Compliant with 3GPP security frameworks, it supports end-to-end signaling and application encryption to avoid data leakage and tampering. It enables interoperation with standard-compliant systems, and adopts hierarchical user authentication and authorization to strictly control access to core services.
- **Multi-vendor Interoperability**
Our devices have passed three major international interconnection tests: the 9th & 10th ETSI MCX Tests and the 5th FRMCS Test.
It also connects with non-3GPP PTT systems such as TETRA and P25. Standard APIs enable cross-system data sharing and maximize the utilization of existing devices.
- **Standard Compliance & Forward Compatibility**
Developed based on 3GPP Release 18 and above, the system adopts global unified protocols and iterates alongside standard updates. It is fully compatible with future versions and network protocols to eliminate technical obsolescence risks and ensure long-term serviceability.
In 2025, we jointly released the White Paper on Mission-Critical Group Communication (MCX) with China Mobile Research Institute. As a member of CCSA, we deeply participate in formulating the domestic standard General Technical Requirements for 5G Mission-Critical (MCX) Communication Systems, which has been officially approved as an industry standard project.

##### 3.1.1.5 低电量卡片 ## 功能简介 低电量卡片功能用于集中展示厂区内电量较低的定位卡片信息，方便用户及时发现并处理电量不足问题，确保设备和人员的正常运行与活动。此功能有效避免了因设备电量耗尽导致的人员失联或定位中断。 ## 操作说明 点击系统界面中“低电量卡片”查看入口，系统将以弹框的方式展示所有电量不足的卡片列表，列表中包含人员的名称、部门、定位卡号、手机号、在线状态、触发低电量时间的关键数据。 如下图所示：
##### 3.1.1.6 统计面板 ## 功能简介 统计面板提供厂区运行状态的“数据驾驶舱”实时汇总在线人员的统计信息区域人员分布情况、不同类型的报警事件实时发生情况以及今日所有报警记录的汇总。通过这些数据，用户可以全面了解厂区的人员活动与安全状况，为管理和决策提供有力支持。 ## 操作说明 在线人员统计：该模块以直观的图标和数字形式展示了厂区内不同类型人员（包括内部人员、外协人员）的数量，帮助用户快速了解厂区当前不同类型的在线情况。

| 6、是否支持视频联动？   | 支持。平台可将人员位置与摄像头关联，点击地图摄像头查看现场画面，也可在追踪人员时联动附近摄像头。具体需确认客户摄像头协议、数量和接入方式。 |
## 5 部署实施类
| **问题**            | **参考回答**                                                             |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1、系统支持云端部署还是本地部署？ | 两种方式都可根据项目需求评估。本地部署通常需要客户提供服务器、固定IP、网络环境和IT支持；云端部署可减少本地服务器准备工作。      |
| 2、现场需要具备哪些网络条件？   | 需要确认定位区域是否有4G覆盖、当地频段、服务器是否可连通，以及数据合规和跨境访问要求。如果没有4G，需要评估有线网络、专网的回传方式。 |
| 3、 视频接入前需要确认什么？   | 需要确认监控平台数量、摄像头数量、摄像头位置、支持协议、接入方式等，视频联动属于集成范围，建议单独确认。                 |
| 4、项目实施通常包括哪些步骤？   | 通常包括需求调研、图纸收集、方案设计、点位规划、设备安装、系统配置、现场调试、功能验证、客户培训和验收。                 |
| 5、项目验收一般看什么？      | 验收可围绕覆盖区域、分区精度、报警规则、轨迹回放、视频联动、系统稳定性、设备在线率和培训完成情况进行。建议在实施前明确验收标准。     |
| 6、该方案的核心价值是什么？    | 核心价值是帮助客户实现人员看得见、风险早发现、事件快响应、事后可追溯，同时通过以UWB、GPS和4G为主的方案降低部署带来的成本压力。  |

操作步骤
- 在设备列表中进入目标设备详情页，再打开“动态数据”页面。
- 在“间隔”下拉框中选择需要查看的数据周期。
- 点击“查询”，系统按条件加载动态数据记录。
- 如需调整列表字段，点击“表头设置”，进入字段配置页面勾选要显示的字段。
- 保存字段配置后返回动态数据页，查看更新后的列表展示效果。
- 如需导出当前结果，点击“导出”。
结果反馈
- 查询成功：表格刷新为符合条件的动态数据记录。
- 保存表头设置成功：动态数据列表按新字段方案重新展示。
- 导出成功：系统生成当前动态数据导出文件。
- 未选择间隔或无数据：系统仅展示空列表或提示无可用记录。
##### 4.6.7.1 表头设置
表头设置页用于配置“动态数据”页面中需要显示的字段。字段按常规参数、无线网络设置、GPS 选项、SIM 卡设置等分类展示，用户可按实际查看需求勾选对应字段后保存。
| **字段**     | **说明**                                                                                                         |
|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 常规参数       | 用于配置设备基础运行状态字段，如电池充电、充电类型、使用的 IP 地址、已启用设备保护、铃声音量、已启用 Wi‑Fi、已启用移动数据、已启用 GPS、蓝牙已打开、USB 存储装置已开启、总内存(Mb)、可用内存(Mb)。 |
| 无线网络设置     | 用于配置 Wi‑Fi 相关字段，如 Wi‑Fi 信号强度、SSID、已启用网络保护、连接状态、Wi‑Fi 连接的 IP 地址、字节传输、收到的字节数。                                    |
| GPS 选项     | 用于配置定位相关字段，如卫星通信状态、纬度、经度、高度、速度 km/h、方向。                                                                        |
| SIM 卡设置 #1 | 用于配置第一张 SIM 卡的状态字段，如信号强度、移动数据运营商名称、已启用数据传输、移动数据连接的 IP 地址、移动数据连接状态、SIM 卡状态、字节传输、收到的字节数。                         |

### 6.2 分步排查流程
遇到问题时，建议按照以下流程逐步排查，不要跳过任何步骤。每一步都有明确的判断标准，帮助快速缩小问题范围。
#### 步骤1：确认服务运行状态
首先确认Pocstar核心服务是否正常运行：
# 登录服务器，执行检查脚本
cd /opt/pocstar/scripts  # 根据实际安装路径调整
./check.sh
如check.sh输出显示服务状态为 异常，请记录具体是哪个服务异常，然后执行步骤2。如全部服务显示 [OK]，请跳至步骤4检查网络问题。
#### 步骤2：查看异常服务日志
定位到异常服务后，查看其日志文件获取详细错误信息：
# 查看各服务日志路径
# 语音服务日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/echt/logs/echat.log
# 网关日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/gateway/logs/2026-05-20/error.log
# 调度服务日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/dispatcher/logs/dispatcher.log
**提示：日志查看技巧：使用 grep -i "error\|fail\|exception" 过滤关键字，可快速定位错误信息。关注最新的时间戳对应的日志条目。**
#### 步骤3：常见服务异常处理
根据日志中的错误信息，参考下表进行针对性处理：
| **日志错误关键词**                          | **含义**    | **处理方式**        |
|--------------------------------------|-----------|-----------------|
| bind failed / Address already in use | 端口被其他程序占用 | 查找并停止占用进程       |
| Permission denied                    | 文件或目录权限不足 | 检查并修改权限为755/644 |
| No such file or directory            | 依赖文件缺失    | 重新安装或恢复缺失文件     |
| Connection refused / timeout         | 连接被拒绝或超时  | 检查目标服务是否运行、防火墙  |

retrieved_chunks.content:
| Out of memory                        | 内存不足      | 增加内存或优化配置减少内存占用 |
| Disk full                            | 磁盘空间已满    | 清理日志或扩容磁盘       |
#### 步骤4：检查网络连通性
如服务运行正常但无法正常使用，需检查网络层面：
# 4.1 检查服务器本机端口监听
ss -tunlp | grep -E "11055|17272|16130|10200"
# 4.2 从服务器本机测试服务可达性
curl -v http://localhost:17272
# 4.3 从客户端测试到服务器的连通性
ping <服务器IP>;
telnet <服务器IP> 11055 ; telnet <服务器IP> 17272
# 4.4 检查防火墙规则
iptables -L -n | grep 11055
**重要：如ping通但telnet端口不通，极大概率是防火墙未放行该端口。请联系网络管理员确认防火墙规则，参考第四章端口清单进行配置。**
#### 步骤5：检查系统资源
服务异常有时是由系统资源不足引起的：
# 检查CPU和内存
top -bn1 | head -20
free -h
# 检查磁盘空间
df -h
# 检查磁盘IO
iostat -x 1 5
- CPU持续高于90%：需检查是否有其他程序占用资源，或考虑升级服务器配置
- 内存使用率超过90%：可能存在内存泄漏，建议重启服务或联系技术支持
- 磁盘使用率超过85%：需清理日志或扩展存储空间
### 6.3 常见问题解决方案
#### 6.3.1 终端无法注册
- 1． **检查终端网络——** 确认终端WiFi/4G/5G网络正常，可访问互联网或内网服务器
- 2． **检查服务器地址配置——** 确认终端上配置的服务器IP地址和端口正确
- 3． **检查防火墙——** 确认11055/UDP 30000-30002端口已放行
- 4． **查看网关日志——** tail -f /opt/pocstar/dispatcher/logs/dispatcher.log 观察注册请求是否到达
#### 6.3.2 语音对讲无声音
- 1． **检查终端权限——** 确认终端的麦克风权限已开启
- 2． **检查语音服务——** 确认语音服务状态正常，无异常日志

操作步骤

- 查看基础资料。
- 通过页内按钮进入“动态数据”等子页面。
#### 4.6.7 动态数据
动态数据页用于查看设备在运行过程中实时上报的状态信息，例如充电状态、Wi‑Fi 连接情况、GPS 信息、SIM 卡状态等。该页面的列表字段支持自定义，用户可根据实际管理需要选择显示哪些动态指标。
| **字段**     | **说明**                          |
|------------|---------------------------------|
| 间隔         | 选择动态数据的查询周期或时间粒度，用于筛选需要展示的数据记录。 |
| 查询         | 按已选查询条件加载动态数据列表。                |
| 重置         | 清空当前查询条件并恢复默认状态。                |
| 表头设置       | 进入动态数据字段配置页面，自定义当前列表显示的字段。      |
| 导出         | 导出当前查询结果，便于留档或进一步分析。            |
| 时间         | 动态数据上报时间。                       |
| 充电类型       | 设备当前充电方式，如交流充电、USB 充电等。         |
| Wi‑Fi 信号强度 | 当前无线网络信号强弱。                     |
| SSID       | 设备当前连接的无线网络名称。                  |
| 连接状态       | 设备当前 Wi‑Fi 或网络连接状态。             |
| 信号强度       | 移动网络信号强度，通常对应 SIM 卡信号信息。        |
| 流动数据连接状态   | 移动数据网络当前是否处于连接状态。               |
字段自定义说明
动态数据列表不是固定字段列表。用户可点击页面右上角“表头设置”，按业务需要勾选需要显示的动态数据字段。保存后，动态数据列表会按最新设置展示所选字段。不同设备管理场景下，可根据关注重点只保留电池、网络、GPS 或 SIM 卡相关字段，减少无关信息干扰。

安全事件发生后，将事件上报至产品中心与运营侧。
将异常服务器隔离出集群，再检查是否有异常用户，如果发现异常用户，立即修改用户密码，pkill -kill -t tty 剔除异常用户，如没有异常用户尽快进行进一步处理。
1. 发现异常进程，立即禁止，冻结禁止。
如果禁止后会自动重启，则需要判断crontab等来找到进程重启的原因，如果有cron项目恶意重启进程，先要对cron进行清理。如果是进程有自启动机制保护进程被杀后重启的话，此时可暂时冻结异常进程(注意不是停止)
发现一个恶意进程后通过 ls –al /proc/Pid (Pid为具体的进程号)，发现进程的启动路径，启动的文件所在目录等信息。
kill -STOP Pid 可以暂时冻结pid的进程，这时此进程将不能正常工作，不能占用系统资源，不往外发包。，被冻结的进程可以通过ps aux|grep –T来查到，此后如果需要可通过 skill -CONT Pid恢复进程。
1. 如果发现异常连接数，通过iptables封禁相关端口或者ip
2. 查看业务访问日志，分析异常访问，对异常访问ip进行处理，对异常访问的文件进行处理
3. 对清理移动木马，杀掉进程。
首先清理掉木马创建的cron 计划项和主要是/etc/crontab文件，和cron.d/ cron.daily/ cron.deny cron.hourly/ cron.monthly/ cron.weekly/等目录下的恶意计划项目; /etc/init.d/下的恶意启动项以及rcN目录下的启动项。记录下这些项目的内容涉及到的文件，然后全部清理到，注意截图保留相应的证据(文件时间签，文件内容等的截图)。

应用案例 Application Cases ## 融合定位解决方案：精准、高效、一体化 凭借在通信与定位领域多年的深厚积累，我们创新性地推出了室内外一体化融合定位解决方案。该方案突破了传统定位技术的局限，以“高精度、低成本、易部署、全覆盖”的优势，引领行业进入全域、实时、精准的安全管理新时代。 ## 解决的核心问题
传统定位痛点解决方案
单一技术无法满足复杂场景多技术融合： 精度提升至亚米级（0.5-1.5米）
部署施工复杂，投入巨大免布线设计： 大幅缩短项目部署时间
室内外切换中断，场景割裂室内外无缝切换，全场景覆盖
维护成本高高可靠性： 核心设备5-10年续航，免维护设计
## 四 大核心能力 ## 技术融合，优势互补 高精度覆盖：融合UWB、RTK、蓝牙、GPS/北斗等技术，根据不同区域精度要求，智能选择最优模式，实现亚米级到米级的全精度覆盖。 无缝切换：保证人员设备在跨区域移动时，定位轨迹平滑流畅，无延迟、无跳变。 ## 工业级可靠性与环境适应性 高防护等级：核心硬件（基站、标签）均达到IP68防护等级，具备卓越的防尘、防水能力。 极端环境适应：通过严格的高低温试验，在 $ -30^{\circ} $C至 $ +85^{\circ} $C的极端温度环境下稳定运行，无惧严寒酷暑。

操作步骤
- 进入“系统设置 / 设备日志”功能模块。
- 填写日志存储时长后点击保存。
- 点击“添加规则”新增规则，填写名称、过滤器、严重性、应用、组和配置后保存。
- 如需调整已有规则，点击编辑图标；如需删除，可单条删除或批量删除。

结果反馈
- 保存存储时长成功后，新时长立即生效。
- 新增或编辑规则成功后，规则列表刷新。
## 5 使用注意事项
- 涉及设备重启、锁定、恢复出厂、密码重置等命令时，应先确认设备编号和影响范围。
- 修改策略配置、应用设置或插件权限前，应评估是否影响在线设备。
- 删除用户、角色、策略配置、设备组合或过滤规则前，应确认是否存在引用关系。
- 地图、远程控制、通讯录同步等功能依赖外部网络或终端插件，若功能异常应先检查设备端插件和网络状态。
- 对权限类页面的任何修改，建议同时做账号回归验证，防止菜单越权或功能缺失。

#### 5.1.1 硬件环境检查
**[ ] 服务器已到位并通电，硬件状态指示灯正常**
**[ ] 服务器配置符合第二章硬件要求（CPU/内存/硬盘）**
**[ ] 服务器已配置静态IP，IP地址与客户提供的规划表一致**
**[ ] 服务器之间网络互通，ping测试通过**
**[ ] 服务器与客户终端所在网络可互通**
#### 5.1.2 操作系统检查
**[ ] 操作系统版本在支持列表内（第二章2.2节）**
**[ ] 系统时间已同步，时区设置正确（建议NTP同步）**
**[ ] SELinux已关闭或设置为Permissive模式**
**[ ] 系统防火墙(iptables/firewalld)已关闭或规则已配置**
**[ ] 磁盘分区合理，根分区剩余空间大于20GB**
**# 快速检查命令
date                          # 系统时间
getenforce                    # SELinux状态
df -h                         # 磁盘空间
free -h                       # 内存
cat /etc/os-release           # OS版本**
#### 5.1.3 网络环境检查
**[ ] 第四章所列全部端口已通知网络管理员并确认放行**
**[ ] 从客户端设备可ping通服务器IP**
**[ ] 服务器可访问外网（如需要在线安装依赖）**
**[ ] DNS解析正常（nslookup测试通过）**
#### 5.1.4 安装包及物料检查
**[ ] 已确认部署模块清单（第三章3.1节）**
**[ ] 对应版本的安装包已下载并校验MD5值**
**[ ] 产品授权证书(License)已申请并到位**
**[ ] 运维工具脚本包（含check.sh等）已准备**
### 5.2 部署过程检查
部署过程中需实时监控各步骤执行情况，发现问题及时回退或修复。
#### 5.2.1 安装过程检查项
**[ ] 解压安装包无报错，文件完整**
**[ ] 依赖组件安装无报错（monit、字体库、iptables等）**
**[ ] 配置文件中的IP地址、端口参数已按实际环境修改**
**[ ] 数据库初始化成功，无报错信息**
**[ ] 各服务启动脚本执行成功**
#### 5.2.2 部署异常处理
如部署过程中出现错误，按以下优先级处理：
1. **依赖安装失败——** 检查外网连通性或切换到离线包安装模式

query: MDM-通过 USB 注册时，电脑无法识别设备。
gold_answer: 安装 Google USB Driver 驱动；在设备 “开发者选项” 中开启 “USB 调试” 和 “USB 安装”；使用原装 USB 线（非充电线）。
agent_answer:
## 结论

知识库中 **POCSTARS MDM 平台的设备注册方式为二维码扫码注册**，未记载"通过 USB 注册"的流程。针对"电脑无法识别设备"（终端经 USB 连接电脑不被识别）这一现象，知识库中《快速适配工具使用手册 V2.5》记载了以下排查和处理建议，供参考：

### 现象
终端通过数据线连接电脑后，电脑无法识别设备。

### 可能原因与检查方法（依据知识库）

| 检查项 | 说明 |
|--------|------|
| 数据线 | 优先检查数据线是否正常，可更换数据线验证 |
| USB 连接方式 | 若已开启 USB 文件传输模式，需切换到"不用于数据传输"或"仅充电"模式 |
| adb 环境 | 确认电脑已正确安装 adb 环境；命令行输入 `adb` 后能显示 Android Debug Bridge version 即为安装成功 |
| 开发者模式 | 确认终端已开启开发者模式，未开启时无法正常识别/监听 |
| 使用前准备 | 电脑需具备工具运行环境，工具目录下需包含 ADB 和 JDK 环境 |

### 处理建议

1. **检查数据线、USB 连接方式及 adb 环境**是否正常。
2. **确认终端已开启开发者模式**。
3. **切换 USB 模式**：若处于 USB 文件传输模式，切换为"不用于数据传输"或"仅充电"模式。
4. **安装 adb 环境**：解压 ADB.zip，双击运行 `adb-setup-1.3.exe`，按提示操作（按指引输入 Y 后回车），随后按"设备驱动程序安装向导"完成安装。
5. **验证 adb**：Win+R 打开运行窗口输入 `cmd`，命令行输入 `adb` 回车，显示 Android Debug Bridge version 即安装成功。
6. **若提示"'adb' 不是内部或外部命令"**：找到工具路径下 `platform-tools` 文件夹（含 adb.exe），将完整路径添加到系统环境变量 PATH 中，保存后重新验证。

### 补充说明

根据《POCSTARS MDM平台操作说明书V1.0》，MDM 设备注册的标准流程为：平台生成注册二维码 → 终端开机进入欢迎页 → 在欢迎页顶部空白区域连续点击 7 次调出扫码界面 → 扫描二维码 → 按引导联网并完成初始化，设备自动绑定并进入 MDM 管控模式。若扫码注册时设备无法完成注册，知识库记载的处理方式为重新扫码或重新生成二维码。

#### 4.6.3 设备绑定（注册）
设备绑定（注册）用于为新设备生成注册二维码。终端设备扫描该二维码后，即可自动完成设备绑定并进入 MDM 管控模式。
**入口说明**
在“设备列表”页面中，找到目标设备，在操作列点击二维码图标，或通过更多菜单进入“二维码”页面。
| **字段**    | **说明**                             |
|-----------|------------------------------------|
| 设备 ID 分配  | 用于指定设备注册时使用的设备 ID。修改后可快速生成新的注册二维码。 |
| 设备编号分配    | 用于指定设备编号分配方式。                      |
| 注册前未创建该设备 | 勾选后，设备在扫码注册前无需预先在平台中完成设备创建。        |
| 设备组合      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认归属组合。                  |
| 策略配置      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认配置策略。                  |
| JSON 信息   | 二维码中包含的注册参数信息，通常由系统自动生成。           |
| 二维码       | 终端设备用于扫描注册的二维码图片。                  |
| 注册说明      | 页面右侧显示的扫码注册文字说明和操作步骤。              |

## 4 功能操作指引介绍
### 4.1 核心功能
- 设备类：设备列表、设备详情、动态数据、表头设置、设备组合、二维码、设备地图、设备日志、远程控制、远程操作设置、设备应用设置
- 应用与策略配置类：应用程序、策略配置、应用设置、二维码注册
- 组织权限类：用户管理、角色管理、密码设置等

### 4.2 登录
登录页用于完成系统身份校验。当前页面包含欢迎文案、账号输入框、密码输入框和登录按钮。
| **字段**   | **说明**                 |
|----------|------------------------|
| 用户名      | 输入登录账号。未填写时系统会提示输入用户名。 |
| 密码       | 输入登录密码。未填写时系统会提示输入密码。  |
| 登录按钮     | 用户名和密码均有内容后可提交登录。      |
**操作步骤**
- 打开系统登录地址。
- 输入用户名。
- 输入密码。
- 点击“登录”按钮。
![image_1786158607499742.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607503058_image_1786158607499742.png)
**结果反馈**
- 登录成功：页面提示“登录成功”，随后进入系统主界面。
- 登录失败：页面提示账号或密码不正确。
### 4.3 顶部导航
登录后，页面顶部显示系统标题、语言切换和当前登录账号。点击右上角账号名称后，可进入个人中心相关页面。
点击POCSTARS MDM可返回首页，不论当前任何页面，点击左上角POCSTARS MDM字样均可返回首页。

**操作步骤**
- 在设备列表中新增设备后，点击该设备对应的二维码入口。
- 进入二维码页面后，按需设置设备 ID、设备组合和策略配置。
- 确认页面生成的二维码内容无误。
- 终端设备保持出厂状态开机，在欢迎页顶部空白区域连续点击 7 次，调出 Android 二维码扫码页面。
- 使用终端扫描平台生成的注册二维码。
- 根据终端引导完成联网、接受条款和后续初始化操作。
- 完成后，设备自动绑定到平台并进入 MDM 管控状态。
![image_1786158607567603.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607570129_image_1786158607567603.png)
![image_1786158607574896.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607577177_image_1786158607574896.png)
**终端侧操作指引**
- 设备开机进入欢迎页。
- 在欢迎页顶部空白区域连续点击 7 次，进入二维码扫描模式。
- 扫描平台生成的二维码。
- 按提示连接 Wi‑Fi。
- 继续按照系统引导完成接受协议、初始化安装等操作。
![image_1786158607582831.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607585213_image_1786158607582831.png)
![image_1786158607592350.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607595113_image_1786158607592350.png)
**结果反馈**
- 绑定成功后，设备自动进入 MDM 管控模式。
- 绑定完成后，MDM 程序无法被手动删除或卸载，设备进入受管控状态。
- 若平台关闭监控，设备可按普通模式使用。
- 若平台开启监控，设备需按照预设权限规则执行操作。
- 若未正确联网或二维码无效，设备将无法完成注册，需重新扫码或重新生成二维码。
设备绑定前建议先确认设备组合、策略配置和二维码中的注册参数是否正确。设备一旦完成受控绑定，后续使用权限将受平台策略约束。
#### 4.6.4 导入设备
导入设备用于批量录入设备。当前页面以弹窗形式出现。
| **字段**                  | **说明**                   |
|-------------------------|--------------------------|
| 选择组合                    | 指定导入设备归属的设备组合。           |

**操作步骤**
- 在应用列表中找到目标应用，点击“编辑”图标。
- 进入编辑页面后，修改允许调整的应用信息。
- 如需调整应用和策略的关联方式，可同步进入“修改配置”页面处理。
- 点击“保存”。
**结果反馈**
- 编辑成功：系统提示修改成功，列表同步更新。
- 不可编辑字段：系统保持只读，不允许修改。
#### 4.7.5 删除应用程序
删除应用程序用于移除应用库中不再使用的应用记录。系统会校验该应用是否已被策略引用，若已被引用，则不允许直接删除。
**操作步骤**
- 在应用列表中找到目标应用，点击“删除”图标。
- 系统弹出删除确认框，提示是否确认删除该应用。
- 确认无误后点击“确定”。
![image_1786158607823873.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607826032_image_1786158607823873.png)

**结果反馈**
- 删除成功：应用从应用库中移除。
- 删除失败：若应用被策略引用，系统提示“应用被策略引用后则无法删除”。
### 4.8 策略配置
在 MDM 系统中，策略配置、应用配置和设备配置是三大核心配置模块。策略配置用于定义设备、应用及用户需共同遵守的通用规范；应用配置针对设备上的具体应用进行精细化设定；设备配置聚焦于设备本身的硬件功能和系统参数，通过标准化设置确保设备稳定运行，同时满足企业对设备资源的统一管理需求。
**操作步骤**
- 新增配置前，应先明确该策略适用的设备类型、业务场景和管控目标。

#### 4.8.4 个性化配置
个性化配置主要用于对设备硬件功能和系统参数进行细化控制，包括网络与连接管理、设备个性化与标准化、辅助功能与安全增强等内容。
**主要配置项**
| **分类**   | **说明**                                                            |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 网络与 WiFi | 支持对 WiFi、蜂窝数据、蜂窝数据注册、WiFi SSID、WiFi 密码、安全类型等进行控制，并可限制自动连接指定 WiFi。 |
| 权限设置     | 支持对 GPS、蓝牙、USB 等硬件功能设置为允许、禁止或不限制。                                 |
| 屏幕与音量    | 可设置屏幕亮度、屏幕超时、屏幕方向、屏幕截图、时间和电池显示、设备音量等。                             |
| 系统控制     | 可对摄像头、麦克风、NFC、数据漫游、限制流量使用、USB 调试模式等进行统一控制。                        |
操作说明
每项配置通常提供“允许 / 禁止 / 不限制”或“固定值 / 自动 / 关闭”等可选项。管理员应根据终端用途选择合适模式。例如可强制开启 GPS、禁止蓝牙、限制 USB 数据传输、设置固定亮度或固定音量，以提升终端标准化管理水平。
#### 4.8.5 MDM设置
MDM 设置用于维护设备注册、受控模式、二维码、Kiosk 权限及服务器迁移等与 MDM 管理方式直接相关的参数。
**主要字段**
| **字段**      | **说明**                                         |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------|
| MDM管理模式     | 支持普通模式和 Kiosk 模式。单一应用模式启用后，终端只能打开 MDM 系统配置的应用。 |
| MDM应用程序     | 当选择单一应用或 Kiosk 相关模式时，在此关联对应应用程序。               |
| 管理员接收类型     | 用于填写管理员接收类，一般为应用包名称。                           |
| 应用程序        | 关联具体应用。                                        |
| QR代码网址      | 用于新增设备时生成设备关联二维码。                              |
| Kiosk模式权限   | 可控制主页启动、最近应用、通知、状态栏信息、屏幕转向、锁屏、退出 Kiosk 模式等权限。  |

### 11.3 Observer Round Table Discussion Observer round table discussions were organised on 29 $ ^{th} $ October 2025 during FRMCS Plugtests event which focused on sharing of ideas, strategies, deployment challenges, conformance testing and performance of mission critical networks during the deployment. ### 11.4 Observer Demos The Observer Demo was a possibility for vendors to present their solutions and features to the observers. The demos took place during the half day on Thursday, 30 $ ^{th} $ October 2025. The following demos were presented:
FRMCS#5 Plugtests Observer Interop Demos 28 Oct 2025, 12:30-13:00 & 30 Oct 2025, 9:30-13:00
Table 16. Observer Demos
## 12 Interoperability Implementation Guide The FRMCS and MCX Plugtests test case document (ETSI TS 103 564) specifies interoperability tests with the purpose of supporting those series of events. It therefore follows ETSI Interoperability best practices, including the identification of requirements specific methods, techniques and tools to be used, the naming conventions including test components and test purposes, the definition of test purposes, among others. As part of the testing methodology, whenever an ambiguity or gap in the standards is identified a so-called observation is collected and conveyed to the relevant working group in the standardization organisation for clarification. However, even with a common understanding of the interfaces and standards to be evaluated during the interoperability tests, some practical or implementation questions arise that may have an impact into not only the interoperability testing carried out during the Plugtests themselves but also while deploying FRMCS systems in multivendor scenarios. The following list summarizes some of the findings during the $ 5^{th} $ FRMCS Plugtests. - Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants and 5GC providers, the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per FRMCS client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team an unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful. - Need for frequency management. The deployment of 5 different 5G radio equipment required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission to the spectrum regulator and coordinating in specific frequency bands. - Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face to face event. • Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 5^{th} FRMCS Plugtests (https://wiki.plugtests.net/5th-FRMCS-Plugtests/index.php?title=Provisioning_Information) specific provisioning information is shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including adhoc calling criteria according to UIC FIS document, PLMN IDs to be used, N5 testing approach for AS providers, details for the domains/realms, Application Servers information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects –MOs- according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone.

Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team, a unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful.
Need for frequency management. The deployment of multiple 4G and 5G radio equipment across seven networks required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission from ARCEP (the French spectrum regulator) and coordinating in specific frequency bands, namely Bands 38, and 40 for 4G and Band 78 for 5G.
Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some EPC and 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face-to-face event. Unique PLMN IDs should be used for each 4G or 5G network present in the Plugtests and support of these PLMN IDs must be supported by the UEs.
Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 10th MCX Plugtests specific provisioning information was shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including PLMN IDs to be used, details for the domains/realms, Application Server information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects (MOs) according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone, consuming a non-negligible part of the test sessions, especially in those involving multiple clients and/or servers.
Role of the SIP/IMS cores and SIM cards. Similarly to the previous, the usage of SIM based authentication and derivation of SIP identities and realms from the ISIM within the physical SIM card for SIP registration and IMS-AKA based authentication is still not available in many MCX clients/UE vendors. Similarly, the automated discovery of PCSCF from the 4G or 5G network signalling was not used. Instead, manual configuration for every SIP/IMS core registrar server was needed, leading again to delays.
MTU and fragmentation issues. The testing setups typically involve connecting to components in different networks (4G, 5G, Ethernet, VPN) even remotely through the ETSI HIVE, with different MTU sizes. Since there is no agreed PMTU discovery mechanism in place and sometimes the MCX components do/can not properly control the Don't Fragment (DF bit) capabilities in IP datagrams there typically appear hard-to-troubleshoot connectivity issues. Although such issues were also announced and reminded to the participants it was still present during the event.

## 3 下载
请联系我司运维工程师获取MCSTARS客户端安装包，并下载至终端设备进行安装。
## 4 安装
### 4.1 安装-无风险提示
当无风险提示时，可以根据终端设备的页面提示直接安装MCSTARS客户端。
安装步骤：
1. 下载完成后，在浏览器的【下载】列表或本地存储（如“下载”文件夹）中找到安装包；
2. 点击安装包，按照页面提示完成安装；
3. 安装完成，桌面自动生成MCSTARS的图标。
![image_1786159050027230.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159050029713_image_1786159050027230.png)
![image_1786159050033245.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159050035357_image_1786159050033245.png)

### 4.2 安装-有风险提示
部分终端设备在安装MCSTARS客户端时，可能出现"未检测到此应用的ICP备案信息"或"安装包有风险"等安全提示。
安装步骤：
1. 忽略安全提示（该提示仅因应用未上架应用商店导致）；
2. 根据页面提示找到【允许本次安装】按钮并点击；
3. 根据页面提示找到【授权本次安装】按钮并点击；
4. 安装完成，桌面自动生成MCSTARS的图标。
注：各终端设备品牌的安全提示可能存在差异，具体以实际显示为准。
![image_1786159050044420.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159050046459_image_1786159050044420.png)
![image_1786159050049849.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159050051867_image_1786159050049849.png)
![image_1786159050055066.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159050057157_image_1786159050055066.png)
## 5 环境准备
1. 检查SIM卡：在终端设备开机前，按照正确方向插入SIM卡。终端设备开机后，观察屏幕右上角的信号标识，可确认SIM卡是否插入正常。
2. 确保网络畅通：MCSTARS客户端需在网络环境下运行才能连接服务器。启动前请检查设备的网络连接（移动数据或WiFi均可正常使用）。
3. 开启GPS定位：MCSTARS客户端需调用设备的GPS功能实现定位服务，请提前开启GPS以确保定位功能正常。

### 3.2 环境准备

- 使用MCSTARS客户端前，请先确保设备已接入可用网络（可尝试打开网页或使用其他联网应用测试），以便正常连接到MCSTARS服务器。
- 使用MCSTARS客户端前，请先开启终端设备的GPS定位功能，以确保MCSTARS客户端能正常获取位置信息。
- MCSTARS客户端的通话、通知音量默认由媒体音量决定，请先将音量调节至舒适状态。
### 3.3 安装软件
详见《MCSTARS Client安装手册》。
### 3.4 授权
在首次运行MCSTARS客户端时，MCSTARS客户端会向终端用户申请一系列应用程序权限，请选择【允许】。
申请的应用程序权限：
- 拨打电话和管理通话；
- 拍摄照片和录制视频；
- 录音；
- 访问照片、媒体内容和文件；
- 获取位置信息；
- 始终处于应用上层。

### 3.5 配置
首次使用MCSTARS时，需先对MCSTARS服务器的连接参数进行配置，才能正常使用MCSTARS客户端。
如何配置：
1. 打开MCSTARS客户端，客户端首次运行时，会直接进入配置页面；
2. 请在配置页面的服务器地址栏中输入系统提供的访问地址+端口（如域名或IP地址）；
3. 点击【保存】。
![image_1786159029376708.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_mvng8u1201/kb-images/1786159029378780_image_1786159029376708.png)
### 3.6 登录
如何登录：
1. 输入账号（账号格式为租户号+号码段，例如：100010004）；
2. 输入密码；
3. 阅读隐私政策并同意；（勾选）
4. 若需要记住密码或自动登录，点击记住密码的勾选和自动登录的勾选；

#### 步骤4：检查网络连通性
如服务运行正常但无法正常使用，需检查网络层面：
# 4.1 检查服务器本机端口监听
ss -tunlp | grep -E "11055|17272|16130|10200"
# 4.2 从服务器本机测试服务可达性
curl -v http://localhost:17272
# 4.3 从客户端测试到服务器的连通性
ping <服务器IP>;
telnet <服务器IP> 11055 ; telnet <服务器IP> 17272
# 4.4 检查防火墙规则
iptables -L -n | grep 11055
**重要：如ping通但telnet端口不通，极大概率是防火墙未放行该端口。请联系网络管理员确认防火墙规则，参考第四章端口清单进行配置。**
#### 步骤5：检查系统资源
服务异常有时是由系统资源不足引起的：
# 检查CPU和内存
top -bn1 | head -20
free -h
# 检查磁盘空间
df -h
# 检查磁盘IO
iostat -x 1 5
- CPU持续高于90%：需检查是否有其他程序占用资源，或考虑升级服务器配置
- 内存使用率超过90%：可能存在内存泄漏，建议重启服务或联系技术支持
- 磁盘使用率超过85%：需清理日志或扩展存储空间
### 6.3 常见问题解决方案
#### 6.3.1 终端无法注册
- 1． **检查终端网络——** 确认终端WiFi/4G/5G网络正常，可访问互联网或内网服务器
- 2． **检查服务器地址配置——** 确认终端上配置的服务器IP地址和端口正确
- 3． **检查防火墙——** 确认11055/UDP 30000-30002端口已放行
- 4． **查看网关日志——** tail -f /opt/pocstar/dispatcher/logs/dispatcher.log 观察注册请求是否到达
#### 6.3.2 语音对讲无声音
- 1． **检查终端权限——** 确认终端的麦克风权限已开启
- 2． **检查语音服务——** 确认语音服务状态正常，无异常日志

### 6.2 分步排查流程
遇到问题时，建议按照以下流程逐步排查，不要跳过任何步骤。每一步都有明确的判断标准，帮助快速缩小问题范围。
#### 步骤1：确认服务运行状态
首先确认Pocstar核心服务是否正常运行：
# 登录服务器，执行检查脚本
cd /opt/pocstar/scripts  # 根据实际安装路径调整
./check.sh
如check.sh输出显示服务状态为 异常，请记录具体是哪个服务异常，然后执行步骤2。如全部服务显示 [OK]，请跳至步骤4检查网络问题。
#### 步骤2：查看异常服务日志
定位到异常服务后，查看其日志文件获取详细错误信息：
# 查看各服务日志路径
# 语音服务日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/echt/logs/echat.log
# 网关日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/gateway/logs/2026-05-20/error.log
# 调度服务日志
tail -n 100 /opt/pocstar/dispatcher/logs/dispatcher.log
**提示：日志查看技巧：使用 grep -i "error\|fail\|exception" 过滤关键字，可快速定位错误信息。关注最新的时间戳对应的日志条目。**
#### 步骤3：常见服务异常处理
根据日志中的错误信息，参考下表进行针对性处理：
| **日志错误关键词**                          | **含义**    | **处理方式**        |
|--------------------------------------|-----------|-----------------|
| bind failed / Address already in use | 端口被其他程序占用 | 查找并停止占用进程       |
| Permission denied                    | 文件或目录权限不足 | 检查并修改权限为755/644 |
| No such file or directory            | 依赖文件缺失    | 重新安装或恢复缺失文件     |
| Connection refused / timeout         | 连接被拒绝或超时  | 检查目标服务是否运行、防火墙  |

   535	#### 4.6.6 设备详情

   560	- 通过页内按钮进入“动态数据”等子页面。
   561	#### 4.6.7 动态数据
   562	
   563	动态数据页用于查看设备在运行过程中实时上报的状态信息，例如充电状态、Wi‑Fi 连接情况、GPS 信息、SIM 卡状态等。该页面的列表字段支持自定义，用户可根据实际管理需要选择显示哪些动态指标。
   564	
   565	| **字段**     | **说明**                          |
   566	|------------|---------------------------------|
   567	| 间隔         | 选择动态数据的查询周期或时间粒度，用于筛选需要展示的数据记录。 |
   568	| 查询         | 按已选查询条件加载动态数据列表。                |
   569	| 重置         | 清空当前查询条件并恢复默认状态。                |
   570	| 表头设置       | 进入动态数据字段配置页面，自定义当前列表显示的字段。      |
   571	| 导出         | 导出当前查询结果，便于留档或进一步分析。            |
   572	| 时间         | 动态数据上报时间。                       |
   573	| 充电类型       | 设备当前充电方式，如交流充电、USB 充电等。         |
   574	| Wi‑Fi 信号强度 | 当前无线网络信号强弱。                     |
   575	| SSID       | 设备当前连接的无线网络名称。                  |
   576	| 连接状态       | 设备当前 Wi‑Fi 或网络连接状态。             |
   577	| 信号强度       | 移动网络信号强度，通常对应 SIM 卡信号信息。        |
   578	| 流动数据连接状态   | 移动数据网络当前是否处于连接状态。               |
   579	
   580	字段自定义说明
   581	
   582	动态数据列表不是固定字段列表。用户可点击页面右上角“表头设置”，按业务需要勾选需要显示的动态数据字段。保存后，动态数据列表会按最新设置展示所选字段。不同设备管理场景下，可根据关注重点只保留电池、网络、GPS 或 SIM 卡相关字段，减少无关信息干扰。

   590	操作步骤
   591	
   592	- 在设备列表中进入目标设备详情页，再打开“动态数据”页面。
   593	- 在“间隔”下拉框中选择需要查看的数据周期。
   594	- 点击“查询”，系统按条件加载动态数据记录。
   595	- 如需调整列表字段，点击“表头设置”，进入字段配置页面勾选要显示的字段。
   596	- 保存字段配置后返回动态数据页，查看更新后的列表展示效果。
   597	- 如需导出当前结果，点击“导出”。
   598	
   599	结果反馈
   600	
   601	- 查询成功：表格刷新为符合条件的动态数据记录。
   602	- 保存表头设置成功：动态数据列表按新字段方案重新展示。
   603	- 导出成功：系统生成当前动态数据导出文件。
   604	- 未选择间隔或无数据：系统仅展示空列表或提示无可用记录。
   605	##### 4.6.7.1 表头设置
   606	
   607	表头设置页用于配置“动态数据”页面中需要显示的字段。字段按常规参数、无线网络设置、GPS 选项、SIM 卡设置等分类展示，用户可按实际查看需求勾选对应字段后保存。
   608	
   609	| **字段**     | **说明**                                                                                                         |
   610	|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
   611	| 常规参数       | 用于配置设备基础运行状态字段，如电池充电、充电类型、使用的 IP 地址、已启用设备保护、铃声音量、已启用 Wi‑Fi、已启用移动数据、已启用 GPS、蓝牙已打开、USB 存储装置已开启、总内存(Mb)、可用内存(Mb)。 |
   612	| 无线网络设置     | 用于配置 Wi‑Fi 相关字段，如 Wi‑Fi 信号强度、SSID、已启用网络保护、连接状态、Wi‑Fi 连接的 IP 地址、字节传输、收到的字节数。                                    |
   613	| GPS 选项     | 用于配置定位相关字段，如卫星通信状态、纬度、经度、高度、速度 km/h、方向。                                                                        |
   614	| SIM 卡设置 #1 | 用于配置第一张 SIM 卡的状态字段，如信号强度、移动数据运营商名称、已启用数据传输、移动数据连接的 IP 地址、移动数据连接状态、SIM 卡状态、字节传输、收到的字节数。                         |
   615	| SIM 卡设置 #2 | 用于配置第二张 SIM 卡的状态字段，字段类型与 SIM 卡设置 #1 相同。                                                                        |
   616	| 保存         | 保存当前字段勾选结果，并应用到动态数据列表。                                                                                         |
   617	| 取消         | 放弃本次字段调整并返回上一页。                                                                                                |
   618	
   619	自定义字段说明
   620	
   621	动态数据页的列表字段由本页面统一控制。勾选的字段会在动态数据列表中显示，未勾选的字段不会展示。建议根据使用场景进行配置：

# Quick Adaptation Tool User Manual ### 1. Document Purpose This manual is used to guide agents and enterprise employees to use the quick adaptation tool to complete terminal button monitoring, terminal adaptation and APK packaging. Applicable objects: • Operators using the Quick Adapt tool for the first time People who want to quickly experience POCSTARS application on their terminals ### 2. Preparations before Use Before you begin, make sure that the following conditions are met: 1. The PC is ready to run the tool. 2. The ADB environment and JDK environment are already included in the tool directory. 3. The terminal can be connected to the computer normally through the data cable. 4. The terminal has developer mode turned on, which is convenient for the tool to listen to the key logs. ## Explanation: Unzip the provided AutoApkTool V2.5.zip, which already contains the required environment configuration in the tool's Env folder. ADB.zip JDK.rar - ADB environment preparation: Unzip the ADB.zip and install it. Install following the instructions in Appendix A: ADB Installation Guide. - JDK Environment Preparation: Unzip the JDK.rar, run the provided executable program (.msi), and install it according to the instructions. If the installation wizard does not pop up, follow the procedures in Appendix B: Solution for JDK Installation Wizard Issue. ### 3. Feature Overview The Quick Fit tool mainly does the following: 1. Select the APK type and unpack it automatically. 2. Connect the terminal and listen for the physical keys. 3. Adjust the terminal adaptation parameters according to actual usage scenarios. 4. Repackage to generate the adapted APK. ### 4. Standard Operating Procedure ### 4.1 Startup Tool 1. Unzip AutoApkTool V2.5.zip tool directory. 2. Run AutoApkTool.exe and open the main interface of the App Adaptation Tool.
### 4.2 Connect the Terminal and Prepare for Monitoring 1. Connect the terminal to the computer using a data cable. 2. Enable developer mode on the terminal. [The image below shows the normal connection status]
3. Keep the terminal in an operational state and prepare to listen to the physical buttons. Tip: If the computer does not recognize the terminal, please check whether the data cable, USB connection method, and adb environment are normal. If the terminal is not enabled in developer mode, the tool cannot listen to the logs normally. If USB file transfer mode is enabled, you need to switch to "Not for Data Transfer" or "Charging Only" mode. ### 4.3 Select the APK Type and Unpack It 1. Select the type of APK you need to process on the tool interface. 2. Optional types include: large screen, medium screen, small screen, screenless and custom, which can be selected according to the size of the screen, where customization is to select an apk from the local to modify the configuration and repackage. ## APK Selection Recommendation: • Screen size < 2.0 inches: select Small-screen type; 2.0 inches ≤ Screen size ≤ 2.4 inches: select Medium-screen type;

#### 2.1.2 测试终端
**单个测试：**
① 点击【终端测试】，进入终端测试页面。
② 对待测试的终端，点击【测试】，也支持批量操作，此时终端可以开机进行对讲测试。
③ 测试通过，则点击【结束测试】，在终端测试列表中，该终端消失，回到终端列表，该终端的测试状态更新为“测试完成”。
④ 测试未通过，则点击【故障机】，在终端测试列表中，该终端消失，回到终端列表，该终端的测试状态更新为“故障机”。
对故障机可以进行如下处理：
- 解绑，释放绑定的充值卡；然后删除；
- 若检查维修处理后，可重新登记和测试。

### 4.13 系统设置
系统设置页采用左侧标签页结构，当前可识别功能模块包括：数据存储、数据清除、设备日志、默认设计、远程密钥、插件管理、电话格式、通讯录、设备相册、URL 过滤、OpenVPN、自定义字段、系统功能定义。
其中“设备日志”“插件管理”“通讯录”“URL 过滤”已确认存在具体操作表单；其他功能模块当前版本更多体现为页面占位或后续扩展入口，本手册仅做用途说明，不强行补字段。
#### 4.13.1 URL 过滤
URL 过滤用于维护终端访问网址的过滤规则。管理员可通过该页面配置 URL 规则是否启用、是否屏蔽广告，以及关联的黑名单和白名单策略，并支持在已有配置之间进行复制。
主要字段
| **字段**   | **说明**                |
|----------|-----------------------|
| 搜索配置     | 按 URL 过滤配置名称进行查询。     |
| 名称       | URL 过滤配置名称。           |
| 活动       | 表示该过滤规则是否启用。          |
| 屏蔽广告     | 表示该规则是否启用广告过滤能力。      |
| 黑名单      | 关联的黑名单规则集合。           |
| 白名单      | 关联的白名单规则集合。           |
| 编辑       | 编辑当前 URL 过滤规则。        |
| 复制       | 从其他已存在配置中复制 URL 过滤设置。 |
编辑字段
| **字段**   | **说明**            |
|----------|-------------------|
| 过滤规则     | 当前 URL 过滤规则名称或编号。 |
| 活动       | 启用或关闭该过滤规则。       |
| 屏蔽广告     | 控制是否启用广告拦截。       |
| 黑名单      | 选择要关联的黑名单规则。      |
| 白名单      | 选择要关联的白名单规则。      |
操作步骤
- 进入“系统工具 / URL过滤”页面。
- 在搜索框输入配置名称后点击“查询”，定位目标规则。
- 点击编辑图标，设置活动、屏蔽广告、黑名单和白名单后点击“保存”。
- 如需沿用其他配置，可点击复制图标，在弹窗中选择来源配置后点击“复制”。

## 1 引言
本服务等级协议旨在明确乙方就 [服务名称] 向甲方承诺的服务质量标准，包括服务可用性、服务支持范围、问题响应与解决机制等。如本协议存在冲突，以主合同协议为准。
## 2 定义
服务周期：一年。
服务不可用：指因乙方责任，甲方用户持续 2 分钟及以上无法完成指定操作（登录、发起对讲），且不属于本协议5免责声明约定情形的故障状态。
停机时间：在一个服务周期内，服务不可用的总分钟数。
约定服务时间：一个服务周期内的总分钟数（如一年365天，则为365天 * 24小时 * 60分钟 = 525,600分钟）。
## 3 服务维度
甲方选择的特定服务等级将决定其享有的服务标准。
| 服务维度      | 描述                                  | MCSTARS                                                                                      |
|-----------|-------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 3.1 服务可用性 | 语音服务处于可正常使用状态的时间比例。                 | 99.99%                                                                                       |
| 计算公式      | (约定服务时间 - 停机时间) / 约定服务时间 * 100%     | 不可用时间：52.56 min  （以每年525,600分钟计算）                                                            |
| 3.2 服务范围  | 所提供服务的广度及服务主动性。                     | 基础服务：  故障修复  技术咨询  增值服务：  主动监控  深度服务报告  主动式运维  （增值服务详见《MCSTARS平台日常运维管理规范》、《MCSTARS平台故障处理规范》） |
| 基础服务详情    | 包括但不限于：预先通知用户后的系统维护（如割接、升级、模拟故障演练）。 | 包含                                                                                           |

# POCSTARS产品家族
依托运营商公网，为中小企业提供私有化部署的宽带集群对讲服务。
依托运营商公网和云平台，以 SaaS 模式为渠道客户提供宽带集群对讲功能与平台运营服务 。
基于3GPP MCX 国际标准协议，包含MCPTT、MCVideo、MCData，提供丰富的多媒体一体化方案。
提供多样化的终端形式，与市场主流品牌和型号无缝集成，构建完善的生态系统。
融合蓝牙、UWB、卫星、RTK等多种定位技术，实现室内外亚米级定位覆盖，为各类场景提供高效、经济的定位解决方案。

## 历史渊源 ## 中华人民共和国应急管理部 关于印发《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”特殊作业许可与作业过程管理系统建设应用指南（试行）》等三项指南的通知 各省、自治区、直辖市应急管理厅（局），新疆生产建设兵团应急管理局，有关中央企业安全管理部门： 为推动“工业互联网+危化安全生产”试点建设深入展开，应急管理部危化监管一司组织制定了《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”特殊作业许可与作业过程管理系统建设应用指南（试行）》、《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”智能巡检系统建设应用指南（试行）》和《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”人员定位系统建设应用指南（试行）》等三项建设应用指南（附后）。现印发给你们，请督促指导试点单位将特殊作业许可与作业过程管理、智能巡检、人员定位作为必建场景，按照指南认真开展建设，鼓励与其他场景耦合、联动建设应用。如有问题建议，请及时反馈应急管理部危化监管一司（联系人及电话：付加鹏，010-64463240）。
应急管理部危化监管一司 《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”建设规范 第3部分 人员定位》（AQ3064.3-2005）是2022年和2023年已经发布的《“工业互联网+危化安全生产”人员定位系统建设应用指南（试行）》、《基于人员定位系统的人员聚集风险监测预警功能建设应用指南（试行）》的继承演进、层级提升、强制约束替代试行引导的关系，前者将后者的建设经验与框架固化为全国统一的强制执行规范，后者是前者的重要技术与实践基础。

   394	
   395	#### 4.6.2 添加设备 / 编辑设备
   396	
   397	添加/编辑设备页面用于新建设备资料，或对已添加的设备进行修改维护。管理员可在该页面填写设备基础信息、配置信息及自定义字段，并完成设备保存。
   398	
   399	入口说明
   400	
   401	- 添加设备：在设备列表页面点击右上角“添加设备”按钮进入。
   402	- 编辑设备：在设备列表中找到目标设备，点击操作列中的编辑图标进入。
   403	| **字段**   | **说明**                          |
   404	|----------|---------------------------------|
   405	| 设备编号     | 设备唯一标识，必填。页面提示禁用特殊符号。           |
   406	| 描述       | 用于填写设备备注说明，便于后续识别和管理。           |
   407	| 设备组合     | 为设备指定所属组合。                      |
   408	| 策略配置     | 为设备指定默认生效的配置策略。                 |
   409	| IMEI     | 填写设备 15-17 位 IMEI 号。            |
   410	| 电话号码     | 填写设备电话号码，格式需符合系统规则。             |
   411	| 自定义字段    | 用于填写平台预设的扩展字段，如自定义1、自定义2、自定义3等。 |
   412	| 保存       | 提交当前设备信息。                       |
   413	| 取消       | 放弃当前编辑内容并返回上一页。                 |
   414	
   415	![image_1786158607554656.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607556664_image_1786158607554656.png)
   416	
   417	![image_1786158607560343.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607562860_image_1786158607560343.png)
   418	
   419	操作步骤
   420	
   421	- 进入设备列表页面。
   422	- 如需新增设备，点击“添加设备”；如需修改已有设备，点击该设备的编辑按钮。
   423	- 填写或修改设备编号、描述、设备组合、策略配置、IMEI、电话号码及自定义字段。
   424	- 确认信息无误后点击“保存”。
   425	
   426	结果反馈
   427	
   428	- 新增成功后，设备会出现在设备列表中。
   429	- 编辑成功后，设备列表中的对应信息会更新。
   430	- 若必填项未填写，系统会提示先完成输入。
   431	- 若设备编号包含非法字符或电话号码格式不正确，系统会提示按规则修改。
   432	
   433	#### 4.6.3 设备绑定（注册）
   434	
   435	设备绑定（注册）用于为新设备生成注册二维码。终端设备扫描该二维码后，即可自动完成设备绑定并进入 MDM 管控模式。
   436	
   437	**入口说明**
   438	
   439	在“设备列表”页面中，找到目标设备，在操作列点击二维码图标，或通过更多菜单进入“二维码”页面。
   440	
   441	| **字段**    | **说明**                             |
   442	|-----------|------------------------------------|
   443	| 设备 ID 分配  | 用于指定设备注册时使用的设备 ID。修改后可快速生成新的注册二维码。 |
   444	| 设备编号分配    | 用于指定设备编号分配方式。                      |
   445	| 注册前未创建该设备 | 勾选后，设备在扫码注册前无需预先在平台中完成设备创建。        |
   446	| 设备组合      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认归属组合。                  |
   447	| 策略配置      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认配置策略。                  |
   448	| JSON 信息   | 二维码中包含的注册参数信息，通常由系统自动生成。           |
   449	| 二维码       | 终端设备用于扫描注册的二维码图片。                  |
   450	| 注册说明      | 页面右侧显示的扫码注册文字说明和操作步骤。              |
   451	
   452	**操作步骤**
   453	
   454	- 在设备列表中新增设备后，点击该设备对应的二维码入口。
   455	- 进入二维码页面后，按需设置设备 ID、设备组合和策略配置。

MDM平台对终端设备的要求及前提条件说明：
为确保MDM平台能够正常部署和运行，请提前与终端厂家确认以下事项：
#### 1. 终端型号确认
请提前明确并提供终端设备的具体型号，以便进行兼容性评估。
#### 2. 操作系统要求
- 设备需搭载谷歌认证的原生Android系统（GMS）；
- 系统版本要求：Android 9及以上；
- 不支持以下系统：
- 深度定制或阉割版Android系统
- 非GMS认证系统（如部分国内品牌定制系统）
#### 3. MDM软件冲突限制
- 设备中不得预安装或已安装其他第三方MDM软件；
- 避免系统权限冲突或设备管理权限被占用。
#### 4. 二维码扫码功能要求
- 设备需支持开机引导阶段的二维码扫描（Zero-touch / Enrollment）；
- 验证方式如下：
- 1.1. 将设备恢复出厂设置；
- 1.2. 开机进入“Hello”欢迎界面；
- 1.3. 在屏幕空白处点击7次；
- 1.4. 若可调出二维码扫描界面，则说明设备支持该功能。
#### 5. 提前沟通要求
- 请厂家在项目初期提前提供终端型号及系统信息，以便完成测试与适配；
- 未经验证的设备可能影响项目进度及交付质量。
MDM Platform Requirements for Terminal Devices
To ensure successful deployment and operation of the MDM platform, please confirm the following requirements with the device manufacturer in advance:
#### 1. Device Model Confirmation
- The exact device model must be confirmed and provided in advance for compatibility evaluation.
#### 2. Operating System Requirements
- Devices must run Google-certified native Android OS (GMS);
- Minimum OS version: Android 9 or above;
- The following systems are NOT supported:
- Heavily customized or modified Android systems
- Non-GMS certified Android systems (common in some domestic brands)
#### 3. MDM Software Restriction
- Devices must NOT have any pre-installed or existing third-party MDM software;
- This is to avoid conflicts in device management permissions.
#### 4. QR Code Enrollment Capability
- Devices must support QR code enrollment during initial setup (Zero-touch enrollment);
- Verification method:
- 1.1. Factory reset the device;
- 1.2. Power on and enter the “Hello” screen;
- 1.3. Tap the blank screen 7 times;
- 1.4. If the QR code scanner appears, the device supports this feature.

**操作步骤**
- 进入左侧菜单“应用库”。
- 通过“应用类型”和“应用名称”筛选目标应用。
- 点击“添加应用”新增应用。
- 在列表右侧操作栏中，可对单个应用执行版本管理、修改配置、编辑或删除操作。
- 勾选多个应用后，可点击“批量删除”进行批量处理。

### 4.1 核心功能
- 设备类：设备列表、设备详情、动态数据、表头设置、设备组合、二维码、设备地图、设备日志、远程控制、远程操作设置、设备应用设置

登录页用于完成系统身份校验。当前页面包含欢迎文案、账号输入框、密码输入框和登录按钮。

MDM平台对终端设备的要求及前提条件说明：
为确保MDM平台能够正常部署和运行，请提前与终端厂家确认以下事项：
#### 1. 终端型号确认
请提前明确并提供终端设备的具体型号，以便进行兼容性评估。
#### 2. 操作系统要求
- 设备需搭载谷歌认证的原生Android系统（GMS）；
- 系统版本要求：Android 9及以上；
- 不支持以下系统：
- 深度定制或阉割版Android系统
- 非GMS认证系统（如部分国内品牌定制系统）
#### 3. MDM软件冲突限制
- 设备中不得预安装或已安装其他第三方MDM软件；
- 避免系统权限冲突或设备管理权限被占用。
#### 4. 二维码扫码功能要求
- 设备需支持开机引导阶段的二维码扫描（Zero-touch / Enrollment）；
- 验证方式如下：
- 1.1. 将设备恢复出厂设置；
- 1.2. 开机进入“Hello”欢迎界面；
- 1.3. 在屏幕空白处点击7次；
- 1.4. 若可调出二维码扫描界面，则说明设备支持该功能。
#### 5. 提前沟通要求
- 请厂家在项目初期提前提供终端型号及系统信息，以便完成测试与适配；
- 未经验证的设备可能影响项目进度及交付质量。
MDM Platform Requirements for Terminal Devices
To ensure successful deployment and operation of the MDM platform, please confirm the following requirements with the device manufacturer in advance:
#### 1. Device Model Confirmation
- The exact device model must be confirmed and provided in advance for compatibility evaluation.
#### 2. Operating System Requirements
- Devices must run Google-certified native Android OS (GMS);
- Minimum OS version: Android 9 or above;
- The following systems are NOT supported:
- Heavily customized or modified Android systems
- Non-GMS certified Android systems (common in some domestic brands)
#### 3. MDM Software Restriction
- Devices must NOT have any pre-installed or existing third-party MDM software;
- This is to avoid conflicts in device management permissions.
#### 4. QR Code Enrollment Capability
- Devices must support QR code enrollment during initial setup (Zero-touch enrollment);
- Verification method:
- 1.1. Factory reset the device;
- 1.2. Power on and enter the “Hello” screen;
- 1.3. Tap the blank screen 7 times;
- 1.4. If the QR code scanner appears, the device supports this feature.

#### 4.8.4 个性化配置
个性化配置主要用于对设备硬件功能和系统参数进行细化控制，包括网络与连接管理、设备个性化与标准化、辅助功能与安全增强等内容。
**主要配置项**
| **分类**   | **说明**                                                            |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 网络与 WiFi | 支持对 WiFi、蜂窝数据、蜂窝数据注册、WiFi SSID、WiFi 密码、安全类型等进行控制，并可限制自动连接指定 WiFi。 |
| 权限设置     | 支持对 GPS、蓝牙、USB 等硬件功能设置为允许、禁止或不限制。                                 |
| 屏幕与音量    | 可设置屏幕亮度、屏幕超时、屏幕方向、屏幕截图、时间和电池显示、设备音量等。                             |
| 系统控制     | 可对摄像头、麦克风、NFC、数据漫游、限制流量使用、USB 调试模式等进行统一控制。                        |
操作说明
每项配置通常提供“允许 / 禁止 / 不限制”或“固定值 / 自动 / 关闭”等可选项。管理员应根据终端用途选择合适模式。例如可强制开启 GPS、禁止蓝牙、限制 USB 数据传输、设置固定亮度或固定音量，以提升终端标准化管理水平。
#### 4.8.5 MDM设置
MDM 设置用于维护设备注册、受控模式、二维码、Kiosk 权限及服务器迁移等与 MDM 管理方式直接相关的参数。
**主要字段**
| **字段**      | **说明**                                         |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------|
| MDM管理模式     | 支持普通模式和 Kiosk 模式。单一应用模式启用后，终端只能打开 MDM 系统配置的应用。 |
| MDM应用程序     | 当选择单一应用或 Kiosk 相关模式时，在此关联对应应用程序。               |
| 管理员接收类型     | 用于填写管理员接收类，一般为应用包名称。                           |
| 应用程序        | 关联具体应用。                                        |
| QR代码网址      | 用于新增设备时生成设备关联二维码。                              |
| Kiosk模式权限   | 可控制主页启动、最近应用、通知、状态栏信息、屏幕转向、锁屏、退出 Kiosk 模式等权限。  |

### 11.3 Observer Round Table Discussion Observer round table discussions were organised on 29 $ ^{th} $ October 2025 during FRMCS Plugtests event which focused on sharing of ideas, strategies, deployment challenges, conformance testing and performance of mission critical networks during the deployment. ### 11.4 Observer Demos The Observer Demo was a possibility for vendors to present their solutions and features to the observers. The demos took place during the half day on Thursday, 30 $ ^{th} $ October 2025. The following demos were presented:
FRMCS#5 Plugtests Observer Interop Demos 28 Oct 2025, 12:30-13:00 & 30 Oct 2025, 9:30-13:00
Table 16. Observer Demos
## 12 Interoperability Implementation Guide The FRMCS and MCX Plugtests test case document (ETSI TS 103 564) specifies interoperability tests with the purpose of supporting those series of events. It therefore follows ETSI Interoperability best practices, including the identification of requirements specific methods, techniques and tools to be used, the naming conventions including test components and test purposes, the definition of test purposes, among others. As part of the testing methodology, whenever an ambiguity or gap in the standards is identified a so-called observation is collected and conveyed to the relevant working group in the standardization organisation for clarification. However, even with a common understanding of the interfaces and standards to be evaluated during the interoperability tests, some practical or implementation questions arise that may have an impact into not only the interoperability testing carried out during the Plugtests themselves but also while deploying FRMCS systems in multivendor scenarios. The following list summarizes some of the findings during the $ 5^{th} $ FRMCS Plugtests. - Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants and 5GC providers, the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per FRMCS client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team an unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful. - Need for frequency management. The deployment of 5 different 5G radio equipment required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission to the spectrum regulator and coordinating in specific frequency bands. - Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face to face event. • Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 5^{th} FRMCS Plugtests (https://wiki.plugtests.net/5th-FRMCS-Plugtests/index.php?title=Provisioning_Information) specific provisioning information is shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including adhoc calling criteria according to UIC FIS document, PLMN IDs to be used, N5 testing approach for AS providers, details for the domains/realms, Application Servers information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects –MOs- according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone.

Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants, multiple 4G EPC and 5G Core providers, and the seven test streams (A through G), the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per MCX client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. The deployment of three 4G networks (Bands 38/40) and four 5G networks (Band 78) further increased the complexity of SIM card management. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team, a unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful.
Need for frequency management. The deployment of multiple 4G and 5G radio equipment across seven networks required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission from ARCEP (the French spectrum regulator) and coordinating in specific frequency bands, namely Bands 38, and 40 for 4G and Band 78 for 5G.
Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some EPC and 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face-to-face event. Unique PLMN IDs should be used for each 4G or 5G network present in the Plugtests and support of these PLMN IDs must be supported by the UEs.
Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 10th MCX Plugtests specific provisioning information was shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including PLMN IDs to be used, details for the domains/realms, Application Server information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects (MOs) according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone, consuming a non-negligible part of the test sessions, especially in those involving multiple clients and/or servers.
Role of the SIP/IMS cores and SIM cards. Similarly to the previous, the usage of SIM based authentication and derivation of SIP identities and realms from the ISIM within the physical SIM card for SIP registration and IMS-AKA based authentication is still not available in many MCX clients/UE vendors. Similarly, the automated discovery of PCSCF from the 4G or 5G network signalling was not used. Instead, manual configuration for every SIP/IMS core registrar server was needed, leading again to delays.
MTU and fragmentation issues. The testing setups typically involve connecting to components in different networks (4G, 5G, Ethernet, VPN) even remotely through the ETSI HIVE, with different MTU sizes. Since there is no agreed PMTU discovery mechanism in place and sometimes the MCX components do/can not properly control the Don't Fragment (DF bit) capabilities in IP datagrams there typically appear hard-to-troubleshoot connectivity issues. TETRA 和 P25 等 LMR 系统被全球公共安全机构广泛部署。这些窄带系统已经使用了二十多年。因此，MCX 服务标准替换传统技术可能需要几年时间,通过LMR 和 MCX 系统之间基于标准的互操作来解决这个遗留问题。
3GPP在第16版中完成了与LMR系统互通的标准化，即IWF网管实现宽窄带融合，为MCPTT和MCData服务与传统LMR系统互通所需的基本功能提供了一个框架。

#### 4.6.9 二维码
二维码页面用于生成设备注册或设备绑定二维码。终端扫码后，可按策略配置或设备编号完成注册接入。

### 3.7 APK下载
在用户列表页面新增【APK 下载】入口，集中提供终端 APP 安装包、配置工具及操作手册的下载渠道，支持通过地址下载或扫码下载，同时二维码可自动写入环境配置信息，简化终端用户的安装与配置流程。
- **入口：** 进入运营平台，依次点击：用户管理  用户列表  APK下载按钮，即可打开下载弹窗。
| **项目**       | **说明**                             |
|--------------|------------------------------------|
| APK 下载地址     | 提供终端 APP 安装包的直接下载链接，支持复制链接后在浏览器中下载 |
| 下载二维码        | 扫码即可直接下载 APK 安装包，同时二维码内置配置信息       |
| APP 配置工具下载地址 | 提供终端 APP 的配置工具下载链接，用于快速配置终端参数      |
| 配置操作手册地址     | 提供详细的配置操作手册链接，方便用户查阅配置步骤与说明        |
- **扫码下载 APK：** 终端使用手机扫码，可直接跳转下载终端APP，无需手动输入地址。
- **自动写入配置信息：** 二维码内置系统环境信息（含context与DNS），扫码安装或打开 APP时，可自动完成基础环境配置，无需手动填写服务器地址等信息，大幅降低配置门槛。

   146	
   147	## 1 平台概述
   148	
   149	移动设备管理系统（MDM）以统一、智能的管理平台为核心依托，深度聚焦原生安卓三防终端、手机、对讲、执法仪、警务终端等各类大屏移动设备的全生命周期管控。该系统集成了一系列强大功能，包括灵活的设备配置，可根据不同场景和需求快速完成设备参数设定。全面的安全策略管理，能针对性制定数据防护、访问控制等规则。精准的应用程序控制，实现应用的安装、卸载、更新及权限管控。可靠的数据加密技术，对设备存储和传输的信息进行全链路保护。以及高效的远程控制维护，支持远程诊断、故障排除和指令下发等操作。无论是企业还是各类机构，借助 MDM 系统都能轻松应对分散终端设备的管理难题。它不仅能确保设备在复杂环境下稳定运行，更能严格保障数据安全与合规性，有效规避信息泄露风险。同时，通过自动化的监管流程和便捷的运维操作，大幅提升设备监管效率与运维响应速度，降低管理成本，为业务的高效开展提供坚实的移动设备管理支撑。
   150	
   151	## 2 编写目的
   152	
   153	本文是围绕 POCSTARS移动设备管理系统产品编制的系统操作手册，主要用于指引管理人员及操作人员快速使用系统相关功能。
   154	
   155	## 3 阅读对象
   156	
   157	使用MDM移动设备管理系统的所有人员。
   158	
   159	平台当前重点能力包括：
   160	
   161	- 设备统一管理与设备状态监控
   162	- 设备策略配置、应用和组合的关联管理
   163	- 设备二维码注册、导入导出、地图、动态数据、日志查询
   164	- 用户、角色、授权关系与插件权限控制
   165	- 远程控制、设备重启、锁定、恢复出厂、密码重置
   166	- 系统日志、系统消息、定时任务、URL 过滤、通讯录等插件能力
   167	
   168	## 4 功能操作指引介绍
   169	
   170	### 4.1 核心功能
   171	
   172	- 设备类：设备列表、设备详情、动态数据、表头设置、设备组合、二维码、设备地图、设备日志、远程控制、远程操作设置、设备应用设置
   173	- 应用与策略配置类：应用程序、策略配置、应用设置、二维码注册
   174	- 组织权限类：用户管理、角色管理、密码设置等
   175	- 系统设置与插件类：系统设置、插件管理、URL 过滤、通讯录、设备日志规则、系统日志、系统消息、计划任务

#### 4.6.3 设备绑定（注册）
设备绑定（注册）用于为新设备生成注册二维码。终端设备扫描该二维码后，即可自动完成设备绑定并进入 MDM 管控模式。
**入口说明**
在“设备列表”页面中，找到目标设备，在操作列点击二维码图标，或通过更多菜单进入“二维码”页面。

| 注册前未创建该设备 | 勾选后，设备在扫码注册前无需预先在平台中完成设备创建。        |
| 设备组合      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认归属组合。                  |
| 策略配置      | 指定设备注册成功后的默认配置策略。                  |

## 4 功能操作指引介绍
### 4.1 核心功能
- 设备类：设备列表、设备详情、动态数据、表头设置、设备组合、二维码、设备地图、设备日志、远程控制、远程操作设置、设备应用设置
- 应用与策略配置类：应用程序、策略配置、应用设置、二维码注册
- 组织权限类：用户管理、角色管理、密码设置等
- 系统设置与插件类：系统设置、插件管理、URL 过滤、通讯录、设备日志规则、系统日志、系统消息、计划任务
### 4.2 登录
登录页用于完成系统身份校验。当前页面包含欢迎文案、账号输入框、密码输入框和登录按钮。
| **字段**   | **说明**                 |
|----------|------------------------|
| 用户名      | 输入登录账号。未填写时系统会提示输入用户名。 |
| 密码       | 输入登录密码。未填写时系统会提示输入密码。  |
| 登录按钮     | 用户名和密码均有内容后可提交登录。      |
**操作步骤**
- 打开系统登录地址。
- 输入用户名。
- 输入密码。
- 点击“登录”按钮。
![image_1786158607499742.png](http://localhost:9000/public/kb_3cm2gz6tyb/kb-images/1786158607503058_image_1786158607499742.png)
**结果反馈**
- 登录成功：页面提示“登录成功”，随后进入系统主界面。
- 登录失败：页面提示账号或密码不正确。
### 4.3 顶部导航
登录后，页面顶部显示系统标题、语言切换和当前登录账号。点击右上角账号名称后，可进入个人中心相关页面。

#### 4.8.4 个性化配置
个性化配置主要用于对设备硬件功能和系统参数进行细化控制，包括网络与连接管理、设备个性化与标准化、辅助功能与安全增强等内容。
**主要配置项**
| **分类**   | **说明**                                                            |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 网络与 WiFi | 支持对 WiFi、蜂窝数据、蜂窝数据注册、WiFi SSID、WiFi 密码、安全类型等进行控制，并可限制自动连接指定 WiFi。 |
| 权限设置     | 支持对 GPS、蓝牙、USB 等硬件功能设置为允许、禁止或不限制。                                 |
| 屏幕与音量    | 可设置屏幕亮度、屏幕超时、屏幕方向、屏幕截图、时间和电池显示、设备音量等。                             |
| 系统控制     | 可对摄像头、麦克风、NFC、数据漫游、限制流量使用、USB 调试模式等进行统一控制。                        |
操作说明
每项配置通常提供“允许 / 禁止 / 不限制”或“固定值 / 自动 / 关闭”等可选项。管理员应根据终端用途选择合适模式。例如可强制开启 GPS、禁止蓝牙、限制 USB 数据传输、设置固定亮度或固定音量，以提升终端标准化管理水平。
#### 4.8.5 MDM设置
MDM 设置用于维护设备注册、受控模式、二维码、Kiosk 权限及服务器迁移等与 MDM 管理方式直接相关的参数。
**主要字段**
| **字段**      | **说明**                                         |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------|
| MDM管理模式     | 支持普通模式和 Kiosk 模式。单一应用模式启用后，终端只能打开 MDM 系统配置的应用。 |
| MDM应用程序     | 当选择单一应用或 Kiosk 相关模式时，在此关联对应应用程序。               |
| 管理员接收类型     | 用于填写管理员接收类，一般为应用包名称。                           |
| 应用程序        | 关联具体应用。                                        |
| QR代码网址      | 用于新增设备时生成设备关联二维码。                              |
| Kiosk模式权限   | 可控制主页启动、最近应用、通知、状态栏信息、屏幕转向、锁屏、退出 Kiosk 模式等权限。  |

MDM平台对终端设备的要求及前提条件说明：
为确保MDM平台能够正常部署和运行，请提前与终端厂家确认以下事项：
#### 1. 终端型号确认
请提前明确并提供终端设备的具体型号，以便进行兼容性评估。
#### 2. 操作系统要求
- 设备需搭载谷歌认证的原生Android系统（GMS）；
- 系统版本要求：Android 9及以上；
- 不支持以下系统：
- 深度定制或阉割版Android系统
- 非GMS认证系统（如部分国内品牌定制系统）
#### 3. MDM软件冲突限制
- 设备中不得预安装或已安装其他第三方MDM软件；
- 避免系统权限冲突或设备管理权限被占用。
#### 4. 二维码扫码功能要求
- 设备需支持开机引导阶段的二维码扫描（Zero-touch / Enrollment）；
- 验证方式如下：
- 1.1. 将设备恢复出厂设置；
- 1.2. 开机进入“Hello”欢迎界面；
- 1.3. 在屏幕空白处点击7次；
- 1.4. 若可调出二维码扫描界面，则说明设备支持该功能。
#### 5. 提前沟通要求
- 请厂家在项目初期提前提供终端型号及系统信息，以便完成测试与适配；
- 未经验证的设备可能影响项目进度及交付质量。
MDM Platform Requirements for Terminal Devices
To ensure successful deployment and operation of the MDM platform, please confirm the following requirements with the device manufacturer in advance:
#### 1. Device Model Confirmation
- The exact device model must be confirmed and provided in advance for compatibility evaluation.
#### 2. Operating System Requirements
- Devices must run Google-certified native Android OS (GMS);
- Minimum OS version: Android 9 or above;
- The following systems are NOT supported:
- Heavily customized or modified Android systems
- Non-GMS certified Android systems (common in some domestic brands)
#### 3. MDM Software Restriction
- Devices must NOT have any pre-installed or existing third-party MDM software;
- This is to avoid conflicts in device management permissions.
#### 4. QR Code Enrollment Capability
- Devices must support QR code enrollment during initial setup (Zero-touch enrollment);
- Verification method:
- 1.1. Factory reset the device;
- 1.2. Power on and enter the “Hello” screen;
- 1.3. Tap the blank screen 7 times;
- 1.4. If the QR code scanner appears, the device supports this feature.

Handling of SIM cards. Due to the large number of participants, multiple 4G EPC and 5G Core providers, and the seven test streams (A through G), the number of SIM cards and the eventual need to swap them for different test sessions depending on the number of UEs available per MCX client vendor demand a careful handling and tracking by the participants. The deployment of three 4G networks (Bands 38/40) and four 5G networks (Band 78) further increased the complexity of SIM card management. Although no issues or complaints were finally reported to the ETSI team, a unified or systematic approach for the abovementioned handling is deemed useful.
Need for frequency management. The deployment of multiple 4G and 5G radio equipment across seven networks required a proper management of the spectrum to be used, requesting the proper permission from ARCEP (the French spectrum regulator) and coordinating in specific frequency bands, namely Bands 38, and 40 for 4G and Band 78 for 5G.
Usage of specific test-related PLMN IDs. Some commercial devices either ban or already have an OEM hard-coded configuration for test PLMN IDs (such as 001 01). This was announced in advance but, anyway, some EPC and 5GC providers decided to change the typical configuration to prevent any problems during the face-to-face event. Unique PLMN IDs should be used for each 4G or 5G network present in the Plugtests and support of these PLMN IDs must be supported by the UEs.
Provisioning information. In the internal WIKI page for the 10th MCX Plugtests specific provisioning information was shared to help the interoperability and reduce the preparation needed for every test session, including PLMN IDs to be used, details for the domains/realms, Application Server information, and conventions for SIP/IMS and MCX identities and functional aliases. However, the availability of bootstrapping mechanisms, the usage of Managed Objects (MOs) according to ETSI TS 124 383 or the adoption by the vendors of off-line (i.e. using MDM/OTA/TP or any other) automated provisioning method is not homogeneous in vendor implementations, making the final configuration mechanism mostly manual and therefore slow and error prone, consuming a non-negligible part of the test sessions, especially in those involving multiple clients and/or servers.
Role of the SIP/IMS cores and SIM cards. Similarly to the previous, the usage of SIM based authentication and derivation of SIP identities and realms from the ISIM within the physical SIM card for SIP registration and IMS-AKA based authentication is still not available in many MCX clients/UE vendors. Similarly, the automated discovery of PCSCF from the 4G or 5G network signalling was not used. Instead, manual configuration for every SIP/IMS core registrar server was needed, leading again to delays.
MTU and fragmentation issues. The testing setups typically involve connecting to components in different networks (4G, 5G, Ethernet, VPN) even remotely through the ETSI HIVE, with different MTU sizes. Since there is no agreed PMTU discovery mechanism in place and sometimes the MCX components do/can not properly control the Don't Fragment (DF bit) capabilities in IP datagrams there typically appear hard-to-troubleshoot connectivity issues. Although such issues were also announced and reminded to the participants it was still present during the event.
